spine.active_goal: Add Windows as a third Field Notes platform that looks and works like the macOS app with no macOS or Android regression, and a GitHub workflow that builds macOS, Windows and Android and publishes them as one release when a v* tag is pushed. Spec docs/specs/windows-build-and-release.md; built by mitosis as three stacked draft PRs (windows-desktop, windows-runner, release-pipeline).

spine.last_session: First run exited 10. Lanes 0 and 2-10 are ok and committed on mitosis/windows-desktop. Lane 1 failed on its extra recorder_key_hint_test test, which used numpadEnter. I changed it to enter in the worktree, and the file passes 12/12. Run resumed.

open_risks.text: Lane 1 stopped after its first Step. The two largest desktop Steps (Windows caption buttons and their contrast on dark surfaces) are unbuilt until the lane is resumed, and the windows-runner MSP depends on them.

desktop-photo-paste-drop's 'a Windows path is classified by its extension' test is red at HEAD only through a renamed constant; HEAD already classified those paths correctly. Disclose it in the windows-desktop PR body.

The installer copies only msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll and vcruntime140_1.dll. A Windows plugin DLL may also need msvcp140_1/_2/_atomic_wait. Unconfirmed: check with dumpbin /dependents on the PR build, or by launching the installed app in the VM.

On the lab's VMware SVGA 3D adapter (Windows 11 Arm64, app running under x64 emulation) Flutter's Impeller OpenGLES-over-ANGLE renderer logged 'D3D11 device was removed' on every launch and the picture froze; Flutter does not recover from device loss. On Windows' software adapter it renders correctly. Unverified on a real Windows PC GPU and on real Windows-on-Arm hardware.

Voice and video recording and playback, and the Meadow, were not exercised on Windows: the lab instance has no microphone, camera or audio output, and the Meadow drawn in software saturates its four virtual cores. Needs a real Windows PC.

key_decisions.title: Windows join window offers only the eight words; no QR scanning on Windows
key_decisions.scope: spec 7.28, join a journal on Windows

key_decisions.title: Stack order: desktop Dart first, Windows runner second, release pipeline last
Windows toast status read through WRL, not C++/WinRT
Caption glyph tone follows the real background: no viewer override, Meadow follows its sky
A Windows recording that cannot leave Videos is kept in place, not copied or dropped
Release workflow: wider PR paths, numeric macOS build name, flutter-action stays at @v2
